# @mission-platform/components

Residual "write once, run on all supported frameworks" components for Mission Platform.
Each component is authored once in JSX with `@mission-platform/forge` and shipped
as Vue 3, React, Svelte, Solid, and Web Component output.

**Current ownership:** `ForgeTag` belongs to `@mission-platform/select`; floating
and notification components plus toast APIs belong to `@mission-platform/float`;
theme components and stores belong to `@mission-platform/theme`. The current
residual export inventory is documented in `docs/decomposition-map.md`. The
historical parity rows below may mention extracted components to preserve migration
context; they are not claims about this package's current public barrel.

This package is the demonstration/reference consumer of `@mission-platform/forge`
(the framework-neutral runtime + adapters live there, the components live here)
and of `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge`: the `./react` and `./vue` subpaths
are produced by **compiling the neutral components to each framework at build
time** with that plugin's **two-stage compiler** (source-to-source → native
compile), instead of the runtime `toReactComponent` / `toVueComponent` adapters.

The same neutral components are **also** projected onto **Storyblok** by the CMS
driver's `generateCmsArtifacts`: each component yields a blok configuration
JSON (a Storyblok *component object*) plus a React `.tsx` / Vue `.vue` **blok
wrapper** that binds Storyblok's `blok` prop onto the already-built framework
component. These ship under the `./cms/storyblok/react`, `./cms/storyblok/vue`, and
`./cms/storyblok/components.json` subpaths.

The package ships **only** these framework + Storyblok builds — there is no
neutral build and no framework-neutral root export. A single `pnpm build`
produces the Vue, the React, and both Storyblok artifacts together.

## Size scale (universal)

**Every** component accepts a `size` prop spanning the canonical `2xs … 2xl`
t-shirt scale (`'2xs' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl'`), defaulting to
`'md'`. Components with bespoke per-size styling (e.g. `ForgeButton`,
`ForgeIconButton`, `ForgeHero`, `ForgePagination`, `ForgeSlider`, `ForgeRangeInput`,
`ForgeRating`, `ForgeSegmentControl`, `ForgeOtpInput`, `ForgeMarkdownInput`,
`ForgeFileInput`) scale that styling across all seven steps; every other component
applies the shared `@mission-platform/tokens` utility, whose
`forge-size--<step>` classes set `font-size` to the matching `--mp-size-font-*`
design token so the element (and any `em`-relative box) scales with the request.
The utilities are emitted by `@mission-platform/tokens`. Two intentional
exceptions: typography's `size` is **opt-in** (unset by
default so the chosen `variant` keeps driving its font-size, and only overrides
it when set). The per-component rows below note `size` only
where it has bespoke behaviour; assume the universal `2xs … 2xl` `size` prop
otherwise.

## Components

| Component | Description |
|---|---|
| `ForgeBadge` | A small status/label chip whose label is rendered through the composed `ForgeTypography` (`caption`, medium weight, inherited colour), mirroring the `@mission-platform/components` `ForgeBadge`. Props: `variant` (the canonical colour set: `neutral` \| `primary` \| `secondary` \| `tertiary` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `info` \| `error` \| `critical`), `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `pill`. |
| `ForgeButton` | The foundational interactive button, mirroring the `@mission-platform/components` `ForgeButton`: the canonical colour set plus a transparent `ghost` treatment, the `2xs … 2xl` size scale, focus-visible outlines, and a built-in accessible loading spinner that sets `aria-busy` and suppresses the click while active. Props: `variant` (`neutral` \| `primary` \| `secondary` \| `tertiary` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `info` \| `error` \| `critical` \| `ghost`), `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `type`, `disabled`, `loading`, `loadingLabel`, `onClick`. (The SFC's `vue-i18n` spinner label is substituted with a plain `'Loading…'` default via `loadingLabel`.) |
| `ForgeInView` | A wrapper that reveals its content with an animation once it scrolls into view. The first **stateful** sample, driven by the neutral hooks (`useRef`/`useState`/`useEffect`) around an `IntersectionObserver`. Props: `threshold`, `rootMargin`, `animation`, `duration`, `delay`, `once`, `tag`, `onEnter`, `onLeave`. |
| `ForgeStack` | A flexbox stack layout primitive that lays its default-slot children out in a single vertical (column) or horizontal (row) line. Props: `direction`, `gap` (`2xs … 2xl`), `justify`, `align`, `wrap`, `inline`, `tag`. |
| `ForgeGrid` | A CSS Grid layout primitive arranging its default-slot children into a `rows` × `cols` grid. Props: `rows`, `cols`, `gap`, `rowGap`, `columnGap`, `justify`, `align`, `tag`. (The Vue scoped `cell` slot is not modelled by the neutral dialect.) |
| `ForgeSeparator` | A visual divider rendered as an `<hr>`, or a centred label between two lines when default-slot content is supplied (horizontal only). Props: `orientation`, `variant` (`solid` \| `dashed` \| `dotted`), `spacing`, `decorative`. |
| `ForgeMasonry` | A CSS multi-column masonry layout primitive that flows its default-slot children into balanced columns. Props: `columns`, `minColumnWidth`, `gap`, `tag`. (The Vue `items` prop / scoped `item` slot is not modelled by the neutral dialect.) |
| `ForgeApplicationLayout` | The top-level application shell — a colour-coded status banner, a header (navbar), the scrollable main content, and a footer — each exposed as a **named slot** (`status`, `navbar`, `content`, `footer`). The status banner's colour and ARIA role (`alert`/`status`) derive from `statusLevel`. Props: `statusLevel` (`none` \| `info` \| `warning` \| `error`), `stickyHeader`. The first migrated component to use the neutral `<Slot name="…" />` primitive. |
| `ForgeHero` | A page hero/banner section composing `ForgeTypography`. Renders an optional eyebrow/title/subtitle, free-form body (default slot), an optional `media` background (with `overlay` scrim), and an `actions` row. Props: `eyebrow`, `title`, `subtitle`, `align`, `size`, `fullHeight`, `overlay`, `as`, `media`, `actions`. `media`/`actions` are **named slots** (`<Slot>`), their presence detected with the neutral `hasSlot` helper. |
| `ForgeDrawer` | A sliding panel — a `position: fixed` `overlay` anchored to a viewport edge (gated by `open`, click-to-close scrim) or a responsive fixed-open `inline` panel at/above `inlineBreakpoint` (reactive `matchMedia` via the neutral hooks). Reports closing via the `onOpenChange(false)` / `onClose()` **callback props**. Props: `open`, `placement`, `size`, `title`, `closeLabel`, `closeOnBackdrop`, `variant`, `inlineBreakpoint`, `header`, `footer`, `onOpenChange`, `onClose`. (Drops the SFC `<Teleport>`, `<Transition>`, drag-resize, i18n, z-index.) |
| `ForgeNavbar` | The top navigation bar composing `ForgeDrawer` + `ForgeTypography`. A `brand` slot, the centred default slot, and an `end` slot collapse below the `sm` breakpoint (CSS) to a `useState`-toggled hamburger drawer. Props: `brand`, `sticky`, `mobileTitle`, `align`. |
| `ForgeVerticalLayout` | A responsive three-column grid shell composing two `inline` `ForgeDrawer`s — an optional `start` column, the main content (default slot), and an optional `end` column become fixed-open tracks at/above `breakpoint` and collapse to overlay drawers below. The columns and their headers/footers are **named slots** (`start`/`end`, `startHeader`/`endHeader`, `startFooter`/`endFooter`), presence-detected with `hasSlot` and forwarded into each backing `ForgeDrawer`'s own slots; `startOpen`/`endOpen` use the `onStartOpenChange`/`onEndOpenChange` callback props. (Drops the SFC scoped default slot.) |
| `ForgeWindowPopout` | Pops its default-slot content into a separate browser window (`window.open`), showing an in-page `placeholder` **named slot** while popped out; the open/close state is reported via the `onOpen`/`onClose` callback props and driven by the neutral `useState`/`useRef`/`useEffect` hooks. Props: `title`, `width`, `height`, `placeholder`, `placeholderLabel`, `popoutLabel`, `popinLabel`, `onOpen`, `onClose`. (The neutral dialect models neither Vue `<Teleport>` nor React `createPortal`, so the popout receives a **static HTML snapshot** of the inline content.) |
| `ForgeAvatar` | A user/entity avatar showing (in priority order) an `src` image, fallback `initials`, or the default slot, sized by the `2xs … 2xl` scale, with an optional presence-status corner dot. Inline-styled (token-driven), so it ships no CSS Module of its own. Props: `src`, `alt`, `initials`, `size`, `shape`, `status` (`online` \| `offline` \| `away` \| `busy`), `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the initials/slot fallback fill), `color` (overrides `variant`). |
| `ForgeButtonGroup` | Groups related buttons (default slot) into a single visual unit; `attached` collapses inner radii/gaps into a segmented control. Props: `orientation`, `attached`, `gap`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting an `attached` group's separators), `ariaLabel`. (The Vue `:deep(...)` child overrides become a plain `> *` combinator.) |
| `ForgeIconButton` | A compact, square, icon-only `<button>` (icon in the default slot); an accessible name is **required** via `label`. The `onClick` callback is suppressed while `disabled`. Props: `label`, `variant` (`ghost` plus the canonical colour set: `neutral` \| `primary` \| `secondary` \| `tertiary` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `info` \| `error` \| `critical`), `size`, `disabled`, `type`, `onClick`. |
| `ForgeQuote` | A semantic blockquote/pull-quote rendering default-slot content (via `ForgeTypography`) with optional `author`/`source` attribution. Props: `variant` (the structural style: `default` \| `bordered` \| `plain`), `tone` (the canonical colour set, tinting the `bordered` accent / `default` background), `size`, `author`, `source`, `cite`. (Drops the scoped `author` slot — attribution is prop-driven.) |
| `ForgeList` | An ordered/unordered/description/plain list rendering the `items` array as `ul`/`ol`/`dl` (each row via `ForgeTypography`); default-slot children are appended after. Props: `items`, `variant` (the structural style: `unordered` \| `ordered` \| `description` \| `none`), `tone` (the canonical colour set, tinting the markers/dividers), `size`, `divided`. (Drops the per-row scoped `item` slot.) |
| `ForgeCard` | A surface container with optional bordered header/footer regions (rendered only when their slot is filled, detected with the neutral `hasSlot` helper) around a default-slot body; an inline-size container. Props: `padding`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the surface/borders — `neutral` keeps the plain surface), `shadow`, `bordered`, `header`, `footer`. (Inlines the SFC header/body/footer sub-components; `header`/`footer` are **named slots** (`<Slot>`) gated by `hasSlot` so presence detection works on both frameworks.) |
| `ForgeCollapse` | A native `<details>`-based disclosure: a `summary` text prop (clickable trigger) + default-slot body, with a CSS-rotated chevron. Toggling fires `onToggle(open)`. Props: `summary`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the border/summary), `open`, `disabled`, `onToggle`. (Substitutes the icons-package `IconChevron` with a CSS-rotated glyph driven by the native `[open]` attribute — no JS state — and the `summary` slot override is dropped.) |
| `ForgeAccordion` (`Display`) | A stacked set of collapsible `<details>` rows driven by an `items` array, with internal `useState` open state; `exclusive` keeps one open (set `false` to allow several). Scoped `summary`/`content` slots fall back to each item's `title`/`content`. Fires `onChange(openIds)`. Props: `items`, `exclusive`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the borders/dividers/summary), `defaultOpen`, `summary`, `content`, `onChange`. (Flattens the SFC `ForgeAccordion`/`ForgeAccordionItem` `provide`/`inject` pair into one `items`-driven component — like `ForgeTabs` — and substitutes the icons chevron with a CSS-rotated `▾` glyph.) |
| `ForgeCarousel` (`Display`) | A one-at-a-time slide deck driven by a `slides` array (scoped `slide` slot, fallback image/text), with controls, indicator dots, keyboard (Arrow/Home/End) nav, pointer-swipe, and optional `autoplay` + a WCAG 2.2.2 pause/play button. Props: `slides`, `modelValue`, `controls`, `indicators`, `loop`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the controls/indicators), `ariaLabel`, `autoplay`, `interval`, `pauseOnHover`, `swipeThreshold`, `slide`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (The SFC derived its slide count by introspecting slot VNodes — not modellable — so slides are an array; `ref`/`watch`/`onBeforeUnmount` autoplay → `useState` + a `useEffect` interval keyed on the active index; `useReducedMotion` → an inline `matchMedia` check; pointer coords → `useRef`; focus-pause and `defineExpose` dropped.) |
| `ForgeTable` | A sortable data table rendering `columns`/`rows` (cells via `ForgeTypography`) with click-to-sort headers (asc → desc → unsorted, firing `onSort`), optional caption, loading overlay, and empty state; sort state uses the neutral `useState`/`useMemo` hooks. Props: `columns`, `rows` (`Record<string, unknown>[]`), `caption`, `striped`, `bordered`, `hoverable`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the head/borders), `loading`, `emptyText`, `onSort`. (Inlines the SFC head/body sub-components; the per-column scoped `cell-<key>` slots are replaced by each column's optional `render` formatter.) |
| `ForgeVirtualList` (`Data`) | A windowed list that renders only the rows in/near the viewport of a large `items` array (inline-styled spacer + offset). Each visible row is rendered through the **scoped `row` slot** (`<Slot name="row" item index/>` → Vue scoped slot / React render-prop). Scroll position uses the neutral hooks. Props: `items`, `itemHeight`, `overscan`, `height`, `row`. (The original SFC was generic + used a scoped **default** slot; this uses `unknown` items + a named `row` slot.) |
| `ForgeVirtualLogViewer` (`Data`) | A virtual-scrolling log viewer with per-level colouring, an optional level/timestamp column, a substring `filter` (with a matching-count toolbar), follow-tail, and an `onSelect` callback; rows compose `ForgeTypography`. Props: `entries`, `itemHeight`, `overscan`, `height`, `showLevel`, `showTimestamp`, `followTail`, `filter`, `onSelect`. (Inlines the SFC row/toolbar, substitutes a colour-coded `●` glyph for the icons, and uses the `onSelect` callback prop.) |
| `ForgeVirtualTreeView` (`Data`) | A virtual-scrolling tree that flattens its visible nodes and windows the rows; a built-in expand/collapse label (overridable via the scoped `row` slot) with `onSelect`/`onToggle` callbacks. Open state + scroll use the neutral hooks. Props: `nodes`, `itemHeight`, `overscan`, `height`, `defaultOpen`, `row`, `onSelect`, `onToggle`. (Inlines `ForgeTreeNodeLabel`, substitutes a `▸`/`▾` glyph for the icons chevron, and uses a named `row` scoped slot instead of the SFC's scoped default slot.) |
| `ForgeVirtualTable` (`Data`) | A virtual-scrolling, sortable data table that windows the body rows beneath a sticky header; click-to-sort columns (asc → desc → unsorted, firing `onSort`), `onRowClick`, an empty state, and a `footer` named slot (falls back to a row-count + sort summary). Each body cell is rendered through a single scoped `cell` slot (`{ column, row, value }`), falling back to the column's optional `render` formatter (or the stringified value). Sort/scroll state uses the neutral hooks; like the original it uses ARIA `role="table"` divs (not native `<table>`). Props: `columns`, `rows` (`Record<string, unknown>[]`), `rowHeight`, `height`, `overscan`, `striped`, `bordered`, `caption`, `emptyText`, `footer`, `cell`, `onSort`, `onRowClick`. (Inlines the SFC head/row/footer sub-components, substitutes a `▲`/`▼`/`↕` glyph for the icons, and replaces the per-column scoped `cell-<key>` slots with one scoped `cell` slot — `{ column, row, value }` — plus each column's optional `render` formatter.) |
| `ForgeTreeView` (`Data`) | A recursive, accessible tree that renders **every** visible node (no windowing) as **true nested markup** — each open branch recurses into a child `role="group"` sub-list; a built-in expand/collapse label (overridable via the scoped `label` slot, scope `{ node, depth }`) with `aria-selected`/`aria-expanded`, `onSelect`/`onToggle` callbacks, and keyboard nav (Enter/Space select, Arrow Right/Left expand/collapse). A single root `openMap` (keyed by `node.id`) drives every node via the neutral `useState` hook. Props: `nodes`, `defaultOpen`, `label`, `onSelect`, `onToggle`. (Mirrors the recursive SFC `ForgeTreeNode`/`ForgeTreeNodeLabel` (no flattening); substitutes a `▸`/`▾` glyph for the icons chevron and uses callback props for the SFC's `select`/`toggle` emits.) |
| `ForgeTimeline` (`Data Display`) | An ordered list of events driven by an `items` array, laid out vertically (`start`/`alternate`) or horizontally; per-item `marker`/`time`/`title`/`content` scoped slots fall back to the item fields, and `variant`/`outlined` tint the marker dot. Props: `items`, `orientation`, `align`, `marker`, `time`, `title`, `content`. (Flattens the SFC `ForgeTimeline`/`ForgeTimelineItem` `provide`/`inject` context pair into one `items`-driven component — like `ForgeTabs` — so the orientation flows from props onto each `<li>`.) |
| `ForgeSkeleton` (`Feedback`) | A loading placeholder rendered as an `aria-hidden` block in one of three shapes with an optional shimmer animation and explicit width/height overrides. Props: `shape` (`line` \| `circle` \| `block`), `width`, `height`, `animated`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the placeholder fill — `neutral` keeps the plain grey). |
| `ForgeSpinner` (`Feedback`) | An indeterminate `role="status"` loading ring with a tone/size and an accessible label. Props: `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `variant` (the canonical colour set: `neutral` \| `primary` \| `secondary` \| `tertiary` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `info` \| `error` \| `critical`), `label`. (The SFC's i18n default label is substituted with a plain `'Loading…'` default.) |
| `ForgeStatusIcon` (`Feedback`) | A small toned status indicator showing a glyph per `status`, sized by the `2xs … 2xl` scale; `role="img"` with an `aria-label` when `label` is supplied (otherwise decorative). Props: `status` (the canonical colour set: `neutral` \| `primary` \| `secondary` \| `tertiary` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `info` \| `error` \| `critical`), `size`, `label`. (Substitutes the icons-package SVGs with `✓`/`⚠`/`✕`/`ℹ`/`–` glyphs; its level type is exported as `StatusIconLevel` to avoid colliding with the layout `StatusLevel`.) |
| `ForgeProgressBar` (`Feedback`) | A determinate/indeterminate native `<progress>` track with a tone/size and an optional label row (label + percentage via composed `ForgeTypography`). Props: `value`, `max`, `variant`, `size`, `label`, `showLabel`, `indeterminate`. (Replaces the SFC's `ForgeStack` wrapper with a plain flex `<div>`.) |
| `ForgeResponsiveImage` (`Media`) | An art-directed, responsive `<picture>` — one `<source>` per `sources` entry (mapped) plus a fallback `<img>` — with native `srcset`/`sizes`, lazy loading, async decoding, a fixed `aspectRatio`, and `object-fit` control. Props: `src`, `alt`, `sources`, `srcset`, `sizes`, `width`, `height`, `loading`, `decoding`, `fetchpriority`, `aspectRatio`, `fit`, `rounded`, `onLoad`, `onError`. (Substitutes the SFC `load`/`error` emits with the `onLoad`/`onError` callback props bound to the `<img>`.) |
| `ForgeResponsiveVideo` (`Media`) | A responsive `<video>` that scales to its container at a fixed `aspectRatio`, with multiple `<source>` entries (mapped), a poster, native controls, and the usual playback flags. Props: `src`, `sources`, `poster`, `label`, `controls`, `autoplay`, `loop`, `muted`, `playsinline`, `preload`, `aspectRatio`, `fit`, `rounded`, `onPlay`, `onPause`, `onEnded`. (Substitutes the SFC `play`/`pause`/`ended` emits with the `onPlay`/`onPause`/`onEnded` callback props bound to the `<video>`.) |
| `ForgeBackgroundVideo` (`Media`) | A decorative (`aria-hidden`) full-bleed background `<video>` (autoplaying/muted/looping) with optional foreground default-slot content and a scrim `overlay`; honours `prefers-reduced-motion` via a reactive `matchMedia` query driven by the neutral `useState`/`useRef`/`useEffect` hooks (pausing playback / showing the `poster`). Props: `src`, `sources`, `poster`, `fit`, `overlay`, `minHeight`. |
| `ForgePagination` (`Navigation`) | A **controlled** page-navigation control rendering page buttons with optional first/previous/next/last controls and MUI-style truncation ellipses; supply either `pageCount` or `total`+`pageSize`. Props: `modelValue`, `pageCount`, `total`, `pageSize`, `siblingCount`, `boundaryCount`, `showEdges`, `showPrevNext`, `size`, `disabled`, `ariaLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Substitutes the SFC `v-model`+`change` emit with the controlled `modelValue`/`onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange` callbacks; the page list is a single data-only `.map()` — the neutral dialect requires an array to be the sole child of its parent.) |
| `ForgeSegmentControl` (`Navigation`) | A **controlled** segmented single-select switcher (`role="radiogroup"`/`radio`) with roving `tabindex` + arrow/Home/End keyboard nav. Props: `modelValue`, `options`, `size`, `disabled`, `fullWidth`, `ariaLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Substitutes the SFC per-segment ref array with a single container ref + `querySelectorAll('[role="radio"]')` for focus, and `v-model`+`change` with the callback pair.) |
| `ForgeBreadcrumb` (`Navigation`) | A breadcrumb trail (ordered list in a labelled `<nav>`) composing `ForgeTypography`; `href` entries render as links and the last entry is the current page (`aria-current="page"`), with a configurable `separator`. Props: `items`, `separator`. (Substitutes the `vue-router` `RouterLink`/`to` target with a plain `<a href>`.) |
| `ForgeMenuItem` (`Navigation`) | A single menu entry — `role="menuitem"` link (`<a href>`) when `href` is set, otherwise an activatable `<span>` firing `onClick` on click or Enter/Space — with a named `icon` slot and a default-slot label (fallback `ForgeTypography`). Props: `label`, `disabled`, `variant`, `active`, `href`, `onClick`. (Substitutes `RouterLink`/`to` with `<a href>` and the `click` emit with `onClick`.) |
| `ForgeTabs` (`Navigation`) | A **controlled** tabs container — an ARIA `tablist` with roving `tabindex` + Arrow/Home/End nav, optional closable/addable affordances, and a `tabpanel` for **every** tab (inactive ones kept mounted but `hidden`, so panel state survives switches) rendered through the scoped `panel` **render-prop** (`properties.panel?.({ tab })`, **not** a `<Slot>` — so it stays a real prop on both frameworks and can be passed as a plain `panel={({ tab }) => …}` attribute from a compiled neutral parent). Props: `tabs`, `modelValue`, `variant` (`line`\|`pill`), `closable`, `addable`, `panel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`, `onClose`, `onAdd`, `onRename`. (Inlines the SFC `ForgeTabList`/`ForgeTab`/`ForgeTabPanel` sub-components, substitutes `+`/`✕` glyphs for the icons; since the neutral dialect cannot express Vue's dynamic per-id slot names each panel invokes one scoped `panel` render-prop with `{ tab }`, and emits become callback props.) |
| `ForgeVirtualTabs` (`Navigation`) | Like `ForgeTabs` but mounts **only the active tab's panel** (virtualised) — suited to heavy panel content. Reuses `TabItem`/`TabsVariant`. Props mirror `ForgeTabs` (`tabs`, `modelValue`, `variant`, `closable`, `addable`, `panel`, + the same callbacks). (Same inlined-tab-bar / glyph / scoped-`panel` **render-prop** substitutions.) |
| `ForgeMenu` (`Navigation`) | An accessible `role="menubar"` of items where an item with `children` expands an inline submenu nesting **to any depth** (one open per level, the ancestor chain staying open); outside-click / `Escape` close every open submenu (document listeners via `useEffect`). Leaf `href` entries are links, others fire `onClick`. Props: `items` (`MenuItem[]`), `orientation`, `ariaLabel`. (Mirrors the recursive SFC `ForgeMenuSubmenu` with a single `renderItems` walk + a path-keyed `openPath` in `useState`; substitutes `▾`/`▸`/`◂` chevron glyphs and `RouterLink` with `<a href>`.) |
| `ForgeMenubar` (`Navigation`) | A horizontal application `role="menubar"` whose items open absolutely-positioned dropdown submenus nesting **to any depth** (one open per level, ancestor chain staying open); outside-click / `Escape` close them. When `items` is omitted the default slot is rendered (matching the SFC's `<slot v-else>`). Props: `label`, `bordered`, `items?` (`MenuItem[]`). (Reuses `ForgeMenu`'s recursive `renderItems`/`openPath` + glyph/`<a href>` substitutions.) |
| `ForgeNavbarItem` (`Navigation`) | A navbar entry — with no `dropdownItems` the childless item renders through the neutral `<Dynamic is={tag}>` primitive (compiled to React's element type / Vue's `<component :is>`), `tag` resolving to `'a'` (enabled + `href`) or `'button'`; with `dropdownItems` a dropdown trigger + `role="menu"` panel (open `useState`, closed via `useEffect` outside-click/`Escape`); named `icon` slot + default-slot label. Props: `label`, `href`, `disabled`, `active`, `variant`, `dropdownItems`, `onClick`. (Substitutes the SFC's `ForgeDropdown` Teleport/`@floating-ui` with an inline absolutely-positioned dropdown, keeps the dynamic tag via `<Dynamic>`, `RouterLink`→`<a href>`, a `▾`/`▴` chevron rendered with the write-once `@mission-platform/icons` `IconChevron` (direction `up`/`down`, size `sm`) like its Vue source, the absolutely-positioned dropdown panel capped at the viewport width so it stays on-screen on mobile, and the `click` emit→`onClick`; the reserved JSX `children` prop is renamed `dropdownItems`.) |
| `ForgeCheckbox` (`Forms`) | A checkbox supporting a standalone boolean or a `string[]` group, with label/hint/error, indeterminate, and required states. Props: `modelValue`, `value`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `indeterminate`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (`useId`→the shared `nextFieldId` `useRef` helper; the indeterminate DOM property via `useRef`+`useEffect`; the check/indeterminate SVGs→a CSS-coloured `✓`/`−` glyph; `v-model`+`change` emit→callback props.) |
| `ForgeRadio` (`Forms`) | A radio selected when its `value` equals the group `modelValue`; the selected dot is a pure CSS `::after`, with default-slot extra content. Props: `modelValue`, `value`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `disabled`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. |
| `ForgeRadioGroup` (`Forms`) | Groups several `ForgeRadio`s under a shared legend, driven by an `options` array (composing `ForgeStack`/`ForgeRadio`/`ForgeTypography`), with hint/error/required and `vertical`/`horizontal` layout. Props: `modelValue`, `options`, `legend`, `legendHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `direction`, `name`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Flattens the SFC slot composition into the `options` array; `useId`/random name → `nextFieldId`; the error text uses a raw `<p role="alert">` since `ForgeTypography` drops `role`.) |
| `ForgeSwitch` (`Forms`) | A `role="switch"` toggle styled as a sliding track/thumb across the `2xs … 2xl` scale, with label/hint/error. Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `ariaLabel`, `hint`, `error`, `size`, `disabled`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. |
| `ForgeInput` (`Forms`) | A text field (`2xs … 2xl`) with label/hint/error, an optional native `<datalist>` (from `list`), and leading/trailing extension content. Props: `modelValue`, `type`, `size`, `placeholder`, `label`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `min`/`max`/`step`, `multiple`, `list`, `start`/`prefix`/`suffix`/`end`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange`/`onBlur`/`onFocus`. (`useId`→`nextFieldId`; the `start`/`prefix`/`suffix`/`end` regions are **named slots** (`<Slot>`), the optional `start`/`end` wrappers gated by `hasSlot`.) |
| `ForgeTextarea` (`Forms`) | A multi-line field (`2xs … 2xl`) with `rows`/`resize`, label/hint/error, and `start`/`end` extension **named slots** (gated by `hasSlot`). Props: `modelValue`, `rows`, `size`, `resize`, `placeholder`, `label`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `start`/`end`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange`/`onBlur`/`onFocus`. |
| `ForgeNumberStepper` (`Forms`) | A number field flanked by −/+ buttons, configurable as a signed/unsigned integer or a fixed-`precision` float. Props: `modelValue` (`number`\|`''`), `min`/`max`/`step`, `integer`, `unsigned`, `precision`, `size`, `label`/`hint`/`error`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange`. (`ForgeStack` wrapper→a plain flex `<div>`.) |
| `ForgeSlider` (`Forms`) | A range slider whose SFC pointer-drag thumb (which the neutral dialect does not model) is substituted with a native `<input type="range">` styled across `sm`/`md`/`lg`; optional `showValue`/`formatValue` badge. Props: `modelValue`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `disabled`, `showValue`, `size`, `ariaLabel`, `formatValue`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. |
| `ForgeRangeInput` (`Forms`) | A dual-thumb min/max range selector whose SFC pointer-drag thumbs (which the neutral dialect does not model) are substituted with **two overlaid native `<input type="range">`** (keyboard + a11y for free); the `[lower, upper]` selection is controlled via `modelValue`, kept ordered with an optional `minDistance`. Props: `modelValue`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `minDistance`, `disabled`, `showValue`, `size` (`sm`\|`md`\|`lg`), `ariaLabelMin`, `ariaLabelMax`, `formatValue`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. |
| `ForgeColorInput` (`Forms`) | A colour picker pairing a native `<input type="color">` swatch with a hex text field across the `2xs … 2xl` scale, with label/hint/error; only valid `#rrggbb` values propagate. Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `size`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (`useId`→`nextFieldId`; the local hex `ref`→`useState` resynced from `modelValue` via `useEffect`; `v-model`+`change` emit→callback props.) |
| `ForgeDateInput` (`Forms`) | A date picker — a trigger showing the ISO date (or placeholder) opens a teleported, CSS-anchor-positioned popover composing the migrated `ForgeCalendar`. Props: `modelValue` (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `placeholder`, `size`, `min`, `max`, `id`, `start`/`end`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (`@floating-ui`+Teleport→neutral `<Teleport>`+CSS Anchor Positioning; inline grid→composed `ForgeCalendar`; `useZIndex` dropped; `useId`→`nextFieldId`; calendar icon→`📅` glyph; `start`/`end` regions are **named slots** gated by `hasSlot`; `v-model`/emits→callbacks.) |
| `ForgeDateRangeInput` (`Forms`) | A date-range picker — a trigger showing the `start → end` summary opens a teleported popover with two composed `ForgeCalendar`s, kept ordered via `min`/`max`; once a start is chosen but the end is still open, the hovered day is fed back to both calendars as `previewEnd` so the tentative range is highlighted as you hover. Props: `modelValue` (`{ start, end }`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `size`, `min`, `max`, `id`, `start`/`end`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Same popover/`useId`/glyph/callback substitutions as `ForgeDateInput`; the SFC hover-driven dual-month grid→two composed `ForgeCalendar`s.) |
| `ForgeDateTimeRangeInput` (`Forms`) | A date-time-range picker — a trigger showing the `start → end (timezone)` summary opens a teleported popover with a browser/UTC toggle and two endpoint panes (each a composed `ForgeCalendar` + scrollable time lists). Props: `modelValue` (`{ start, end, timezone }`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `size`, `showSeconds`, `min`, `max`, `id`, `startContent`/`endContent`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Same substitutions as `ForgeDateInput`; the parse/format/timezone logic lives in the co-located `date-time.ts`; the `start`/`end` slots are the `startContent`/`endContent` **named slots** since `start`/`end` denote endpoints.) |
| `ForgeTimeInput` (`Forms`) | A time picker — a trigger showing the `HH:MM[:SS]` time opens a teleported popover with scrollable hour/minute(/second) lists. Props: `modelValue` (`HH:MM`/`HH:MM:SS`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `size`, `showSeconds`, `id`, `start`/`end`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (`@floating-ui`+Teleport→neutral `<Teleport>`+CSS Anchor Positioning; the inline parse/format logic→the co-located `date-time.ts`; local `ref`s→`useState` resynced via `useEffect`; clock icon→`🕒` glyph; `useId`→`nextFieldId`; `v-model`/emits→callbacks.) |
| `ForgeTimeRangeInput` (`Forms`) | A time-range picker — a trigger showing the `start → end` summary opens a teleported popover with two endpoint groups of scrollable hour/minute(/second) lists. Props: `modelValue` (`{ start, end }`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `size`, `showSeconds`, `id`, `startContent`/`endContent`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Same substitutions as `ForgeTimeInput`; the `start`/`end` slots are the `startContent`/`endContent` **named slots** since `start`/`end` denote endpoints.) |
| `ForgeCodeBlock` (`Display`) | A syntax-highlighted code viewer — a header (filename/language + copy button) above a scrollable body — highlighting `code` with **`highlight.js`** (kept verbatim). Props: `code`, `language`, `filename`, `showLineNumbers`, `showCopyButton`, `maxHeight`, `size`, `variant` (the canonical colour set, tinting the border/header). (`v-html`→a `useRef` host + `useEffect` `innerHTML` (the `ForgeWindowPopout` escape-hatch), so the markup is injected client-side and the SSR shell is the header + `pre > code.hljs`; `computed`→`useMemo`; copy `ref`+`setTimeout`→`useState`+`useRef` timer; copy SVGs→`⧉`/`✓` glyphs; the global hljs token theme ships as the bare-side-effect `forge-code-block.hljs.css` — the one place this package ships non-module global CSS so the `.hljs-*` classes aren't hashed.) |
| `ForgeMarkdownInput` (`Forms`) | A Markdown editor with a write/preview tab bar, a glyph formatting toolbar + textarea, and a **`marked`**-rendered preview (kept verbatim). Props: `modelValue`, `rows`, `size` (`sm`\|`md`\|`lg`), `placeholder`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `required`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange`/`onBlur`/`onFocus`. (`v-html` preview→the `useRef`+`useEffect` `innerHTML` escape-hatch (client-injected; SSR is the shell); `computed`→`useMemo`; active tab `ref`→`useState`; toolbar icon SVGs→text glyphs; `useId`→`nextFieldId`; `useI18n` labels→plain strings; `v-model`/emits→callbacks.) |
| `ForgeMonacoEditor` (`Forms`) | The Monaco code editor, mounted **imperatively** on a `useRef` host. Props: `modelValue`, `language`, `theme`, `readonly`, `minimap`, `lineNumbers`, `wordWrap`, `height`, `fontSize`, `tabSize`, `scrollBeyondLastLine`, `automaticLayout`, `completionProvider`, `spellCheck`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onChange`/`onBlur`/`onFocus`/`onReady`. (A mount `useEffect` `await import('monaco-editor')` — kept out of the synchronous module graph for SSG-safety, so SSR renders only the empty host; `shallowRef`/`ref`→`useRef`; each `watch`→a per-prop `useEffect`; emits→callbacks; its `fontFamily`/`codeLensFontFamily` are sourced from the `@mission-platform/tokens` `font` design tokens (mono/sans), matching the SFC; the Vue-only `useHarperMonaco`/`useHunspellMonaco` spell-check composables are **not bundled** (heavy browser-only WASM) — attach them from `onReady(editor)` (a documented gap).) |
| `ForgeSchemaForm` (`Forms`) | A **JSON-Schema-driven** form at full parity with the Vue original: both the rendered controls and the validation rules are derived from a `schema` through the shared **`@mission-platform/forms-core`** (so the two frameworks validate identically). A single object renders a one-step form; a top-level array renders a multi-step **wizard** (via `ForgeFormWizard`). Supports nested **field sets**, `ui.visibleWhen` **conditional visibility**, and **Ajv** validation surfaced as per-field errors. Props: `schema` (`SchemaFormDefinition`), `modelValue` (`FormValues`), `disabled`, `validationMode` (`per-step`\|`final`), `onUpdateModelValue`/`onSubmit`, plus an overridable `actions` slot. (The SFC's dynamic `<component :is>` control resolution becomes a static `switch` over the resolved field type; generated messages use the built-in English fallback — the neutral dialect has no i18n; `v-model`/emits→callbacks.) |
| `ForgeFormWizard` (`Forms`) | A multi-step form shell — a clickable step indicator, the active step's body, and a back/next/finish footer. Steps can be **conditional** (`when: false` drops a step from the sequence entirely) and **validated per step** (`valid: false` blocks Next, the final Finish, and forward indicator jumps, and disables the primary button) — so the last visible step's `valid` doubles as **final-step validation**; validity/visibility are parent-supplied so the component stays controlled. Props: `steps` (`{ id, title, description?, error?, when?, valid?, content? }[]`), `modelValue` (active index), `linear`, `backLabel`/`nextLabel`/`finishLabel`, `footer`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onNext`/`onPrev`/`onComplete`. (Inlines the SFC `Steps`/`Content`/`Footer` sub-components; the per-step scoped slot stays each step's `content` `MpChild` and the footer the `footer` **named slot** (`<Slot>`); `useI18n` labels→props; `v-model`/emits→callbacks; the active index stays controlled.) |
| `ForgeFormBuilder` (`Forms`) | A visual form designer at full parity with the Vue original — a three-column `ForgeVerticalLayout` (field **palette** · tabbed centre **Editor**/**Steps**/**Preview**/**Schema** · **inspector**). The whole (possibly nested, possibly multi-step) field tree is authored through the shared **`@mission-platform/forms-core`** and emitted as a `SchemaFormDefinition` ready to feed straight into `ForgeSchemaForm` (live **Preview** tab + JSON **Schema** export tab). The palette (`DEFAULT_FIELD_TYPES`) covers **every** `FormFieldType` the form can render (text/textarea/markdown/email/password/url/tel, number/stepper, select/multiselect/radio, checkbox/switch, date/time/datetime + date/time/datetime ranges, file, location) plus the grouping **field set**. The inspector edits the selected field's properties — including the **input-specific** options (text length/pattern, multi-line rows, number min/max/step/integer/unsigned, date min/max, show-seconds, file accept/multiple, location coordinate format) — plus a **conditional-visibility** editor; field sets nest recursively; a **Steps** tab edits the wizard. Props: `modelValue` (`SchemaFormDefinition`), `title`, `description`, `wizard`, `disabled`, `fieldTypes`, `startDraggable`/`endDraggable`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onUpdateTitle`/`onUpdateDescription`. (`@dnd-kit/vue`→**native HTML5 drag-and-drop** element event props; the palette/canvas/properties/condition/steps sub-components are inlined; `v-model`/emits→callbacks.) |
| `ForgeScheduler` (`Forms`) | A full calendar/scheduler at parity with the Vue original — a toolbar (Today / prev-next / title / new-event / five-view switcher) above the active view: a **time grid** (`day`/`three-day`/`week`) with hour rows + column-collision event placement, a **month grid** (6×7), or a **year grid** (12 mini-months). Events are RFC 5545 `VEvent`s and all heavy logic (recurrence expansion, view ranges, the collision layout, duration formatting) comes from the shared **`@mission-platform/scheduler-core`** (consumed identically by the Vue component). Time-grid events drag to a new time + resize (pointer-drag helper); a `ForgeDialog`-based dialog creates/edits/deletes events. Props: `modelValue` (`VEvent[]`), `defaultView`, `weekStartsOn`, `onUpdateModelValue`/`onEventClick`. (`@mission-platform/icons` chevrons→`‹`/`›` glyphs; `vue-i18n` labels→inline strings; `v-model` + the `event-click` emit→callback props; the native datetime-local pickers in the dialog→`ForgeInput` text fields.) |
| `ForgeOtpInput` (`Forms`) | A segmented one-time-password input of `length` cells bound to one string `modelValue`; typing advances focus, Backspace steps back, paste distributes the code. Props: `modelValue`, `length`, `type`, `disabled`, `autofocus`, `mask`, `size`, `ariaLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onComplete`. (The Vue template ref-array→a single container `useRef`+`querySelectorAll`; `nextTick` dropped; the `onMounted` autofocus→a `useEffect`.) |
| `ForgeRating` (`Forms`) | A star rating (`★` glyph layers — empty tinted, fill clipped by width) with half-star precision, hover preview (`useState`, a `-1` sentinel), and a read-only `role="img"` mode (interactive `role="slider"`). Props: `modelValue`, `max`, `allowHalf`, `readonly`, `disabled`, `clearable`, `size`, `ariaLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Substitutes the inline star SVGs with the `★` glyph.) |
| `ForgeSearchInput` (`Forms`) | A `type="search"` field with a leading `⌕` glyph (or loading spinner) and a trailing `✕` clear button; Enter fires `onSearch`, Escape clears. Props: `modelValue`, `placeholder`, `size`, `disabled`, `loading`, `id`, `clearLabel`, `loadingLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onSearch`, `onClear`. (`IconSearch`/`IconClose`→`⌕`/`✕` glyphs; the `useI18n` labels→props.) |
| `ForgeFieldSet` (`Forms`) | A semantic `<fieldset>` grouping container with an optional `<legend>`/description around default-slot content; `disabled` uses the native `<fieldset disabled>` behaviour. Props: `legend`, `description`, `disabled`, `flush`. (The `ForgeStack` content wrapper→a flex `<div>`; the `legend` named slot is reduced to the `legend` prop.) |
| `ForgeFileInput` (`Forms`) | A visually-hidden native `<input type="file">` fronted by a browse-button row or a `dragDrop` dropzone, with a label/hint/error trio. Props: `modelValue`, `multiple`, `accept`, `capture`, `label`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `dragDrop`, `browseLabel`/`dragLabel`/`noFileLabel`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (`useId`→`nextFieldId`; the drag/selection state via `useState`; the icons-package `IconUpload`→a `⬆` glyph; the `useI18n` labels→props.) |
| `ForgeSelect` (`Forms`) | A custom combobox/select — a button trigger + a listbox of `options` rendered through the write-once **`ForgeDropdown`** (combobox in its `trigger` slot, listbox in its default slot, open synced via `onUpdateOpen`), backed by a visually-hidden native `<select>` for autofill/form submission; keyboard (Enter/Space/Arrows/Escape) nav and `start`/`end` named slots. Props: `modelValue`, `options`, `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `autocomplete`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`, `onBlur`, `onFocus`. (Renders the floating list through `ForgeDropdown` via the neutral named-slot **passing** syntax — so the panel is `<Teleport>`-portalled and CSS-anchor-positioned, mounted only while open; the icons chevron→a CSS-rotated `▾`, `useId`→`nextFieldId`, and `v-model`/emits→callback props.) |
| `ForgeMultiselect` (`Forms`) | A tag-based multi-select combobox: removable `ForgeTag` chips for the selection + an inline search input filtering the remaining `options` in a listbox rendered through the write-once **`ForgeDropdown`** (combobox in its `trigger` slot, list in its default slot, open synced via `onUpdateOpen`), backed by a hidden native `<select multiple>`. Props: `modelValue` (`(string \| number)[]`), `options`, `size`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `autocomplete`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (Renders the floating list through `ForgeDropdown` via named-slot passing, same as `ForgeSelect`; the search query is internal `useState`; `mp-font-*` mixins inlined as `var(--mp-font-*)`.) |
| `ForgePhoneInput` (`Forms`) | An international phone-number field — a country `<select>` (flag + name + dial code) beside a `type="tel"` field that is formatted as-you-type and validated with **`@mission-platform/phone-number`** (via the co-located framework-agnostic `phone.ts` helper); the canonical **E.164** form + validity (`✓`/`✕`) are derived each render and a hidden `name` input submits the E.164 value. The national text is controlled via `modelValue`/`onUpdateModelValue` and the region via `country`/`onUpdateCountry`; `onChange` reports `{ national, e164, valid, country }`. Props: `modelValue`, `country`, `countries`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `placeholder`, `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `countryLabel`, `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onUpdateCountry`, `onChange`. (`useId`→`nextFieldId`; the validity icons→`✓`/`✕` glyphs; `v-model`/emits→callback props.) |
| `ForgeChatBubble` (`Communication`) | A single message bubble rendered as an `<li>` composing `ForgeAvatar`/`ForgeTypography` — an optional avatar, a meta line (`author`/`timestamp`), and the message body (default slot); `side` anchors start/end and `variant` tints an outgoing bubble. Props: `side`, `variant`, `author`, `timestamp`, `avatar`, `avatarAlt`, `avatarContent`, `footer`, `pending`. (The SFC `avatar`/`footer` slots are the `avatarContent`/`footer` **named slots** (`<Slot>`), presence-detected with `hasSlot`.) |
| `ForgeChatArea` (`Communication`) | A scrollable conversation surface: an optional `header` slot, an `aria-live="polite"` `role="log"` message list (default slot, typically `ForgeChatBubble`s), and an optional `footer` slot, with autoplay-style pin-to-bottom. Props: `autoScroll`, `autoScrollThreshold`, `ariaLabel`. (The SFC `onMounted`/`watch`/`ResizeObserver` auto-scroll → one neutral `useEffect`; the "pinned" flag → a `useRef`; `defineExpose({ scrollToBottom })` dropped; empty header/footer hidden via `:empty`.) |
| `ForgeLocationInput` (`Forms`) | A geographic coordinate input composing `ForgeSelect`/`ForgeInput`/`ForgeTypography` — captures a latitude/longitude point in Decimal Degrees / Degrees-Minutes / Degrees-Minutes-Seconds (format selector); the canonical model always carries signed decimal-degree `lat`/`lng`. Props: `modelValue`, `label`, `labelHidden`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, `required`, `format`, `allowFormatChange`, `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `id`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`. (The DD/DM/DMS conversion logic ships as the co-located framework-agnostic `location.ts`; `useId`→`nextFieldId`; the local text buffers→`useState` resynced from the model via `useEffect`; the child layout classes moved onto wrapper `<div>`s since `ForgeSelect`/`ForgeInput` do not forward `class`; `v-model`/emits→callback props.) |
| `ForgeCalendar` (`Forms`) | A month-grid date picker — a navigable Sunday-first grid of selectable days honouring `min`/`max` bounds and a `disabledDates` list, IANA-timezone aware via **`luxon`**, composing `ForgeTypography` for the labels. Clicking the month label swaps the day grid for a twelve-month grid and clicking the year swaps it for a decade year grid that pages in groups of ten (2026 → 2020–2029); `rangeStart`/`rangeEnd` highlight a selected range (start/end caps + in-between days, matching the original Vue range styling); and `flat` drops the calendar's own border/shadow/background so it sits flush inside an already-bordered container (e.g. a `ForgeDropdown` panel) without a doubled outline. Props: `modelValue` (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), `min`, `max`, `disabledDates`, `rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`, `previewEnd` (a tentative range end, typically the hovered day, previewed while a `rangeStart` is set but no `rangeEnd`), `flat`, `size` (`2xs … 2xl`), `timezone`, `onUpdateModelValue`, `onChange`, `onHoverDate` (the day under the cursor, for previewing the range). (The `ref` view state→`useState` (incl. the `days`/`months`/`years` view); the `computed` grid→`useMemo`; the external-sync `watch`→`useEffect`; the icons chevrons→`‹`/`›` glyphs; `v-model`/emits→callback props.) |
| `ForgeQrCode` (`Data Display`) | A scannable QR code drawn as a crisp, resolution-independent SVG (a single `<path>` covers all dark modules); the payload is encoded entirely client-side by **`@mission-platform/qr-code`** (a dependency-free byte-mode encoder written in AssemblyScript and compiled to WebAssembly). An opt-in action toolbar can **save the code as a PNG**, **copy the image to the clipboard**, and **copy the value to the clipboard**. Props: `value`, `errorCorrection` (`L` \| `M` \| `Q` \| `H`), `size`, `margin`, `color`, `background`, `ariaLabel`, `showActions` (`true` for the whole toolbar, or `{ download?, copyImage?, copyValue? }`), `downloadFileName`, `onError`. (The `computed` render→`useMemo`; the `error` emit→the `onError` callback prop, invoked when encoding fails or an action errors; the PNG is rasterised by drawing the SVG onto a canvas.) |

These are the **complete** `Components/Layout` group, the self-contained /
dependency-light `Components/Display` components (`ForgeAvatar`,
`ForgeButtonGroup`, `ForgeIconButton`, `ForgeTag`, `ForgeQuote`, `ForgeList`,
`ForgeCard`, `ForgeCollapse`, `ForgeTable`, `ForgeAccordion`, `ForgeCarousel`,
alongside the earlier `ForgeBadge`/`ForgeButton`/`ForgeTypography`), the
**complete** `Components/Data` group
(`ForgeVirtualList`, `ForgeVirtualLogViewer`, `ForgeVirtualTreeView`,
`ForgeVirtualTable`, `ForgeTreeView`, `ForgeTimeline`, and the self-contained
`ForgeQrCode` — whose payload is encoded client-side by the WebAssembly
**`@mission-platform/qr-code`** encoder, with the `computed` render → `useMemo`,
the `error` emit → the `onError` callback prop, and an opt-in save-as-image /
copy-image / copy-value action toolbar), the **complete** `Components/Theme`
group (`ForgeThemeToggle`, `ForgeThemeProvider`, `ForgeThemeComposer` — sharing
state via the observable singleton `theme-store.ts` instead of provide/inject),
the **complete** `Components/Feedback` group (`ForgeSkeleton`, `ForgeSpinner`,
`ForgeStatusIcon`, `ForgeProgressBar`, `ForgeAlertBanner`, `ForgeToast` — icons
substituted with text glyphs, `v-model`/emits with the controlled
`modelValue`/`onUpdateModelValue`/`onDismiss` callbacks, and the `useToast`
store + `ForgeToastContainer` orchestration restored via the shared
`toast-store` singleton — `ForgeToastContainer` animates its stack with the
neutral `<TransitionGroup name="forge-toast">` primitive, matching the Vue SFC's
`<TransitionGroup>`), and the
**complete** `Components/Media` group (`ForgeResponsiveImage`,
`ForgeResponsiveVideo`, `ForgeBackgroundVideo` — `<source>` entries mapped from
the `sources` array, the native `load`/`error`/`play`/`pause`/`ended` emits
exposed as `onLoad`/`onError`/`onPlay`/`onPause`/`onEnded` callback props, and
`ForgeBackgroundVideo`'s `prefers-reduced-motion` handling driven by a reactive
`matchMedia` query through the neutral hooks), and the **complete**
`Components/Navigation` group (`ForgePagination`, `ForgeSegmentControl`,
`ForgeBreadcrumb`, `ForgeMenuItem`, `ForgeTabs`, `ForgeVirtualTabs`, `ForgeMenu`,
`ForgeMenubar`, `ForgeNavbarItem` — `v-model`/emits replaced by the controlled
`modelValue`/`onUpdateModelValue` + callback-prop convention, `vue-router`
`RouterLink` by a plain `<a href>`, icons by text glyphs, multi-file
tab/menu sub-component trees inlined, the `ForgeDropdown` overlay substituted
with an inline absolutely-positioned dropdown; `ForgeMenu`/`ForgeMenubar` recurse
**to any depth** via a single `renderItems` walk + a path-keyed `openPath`,
`ForgeNavbarItem` keeps its dynamic host tag via the `<Dynamic is>` primitive, and
`ForgeTabs`/`ForgeVirtualTabs` drive panels through one scoped `panel` render-prop with
`useEffect` document listeners for dismissal),
most of the `Components/Forms` group (`ForgeCheckbox`, `ForgeRadio`,
`ForgeRadioGroup`, `ForgeSwitch`, `ForgeInput`, `ForgeTextarea`, `ForgeNumberStepper`,
`ForgeSlider`, `ForgeRangeInput`, `ForgeColorInput`, `ForgeOtpInput`, `ForgeRating`,
`ForgeSearchInput`, `ForgeFieldSet`,
`ForgeFileInput`, `ForgeSelect`, `ForgeMultiselect`, `ForgePhoneInput`,
`ForgeLocationInput`, `ForgeCalendar`, `ForgeDateInput`, `ForgeDateRangeInput`,
`ForgeDateTimeRangeInput`, `ForgeTimeInput`, `ForgeTimeRangeInput` — the
`ForgeRangeInput` dual pointer-drag thumbs substituted with two overlaid native
`<input type="range">` (the `ForgeSlider` precedent), the `ForgeColorInput` hex
text buffer held in `useState` and resynced from `modelValue` via `useEffect`, the
`ForgeSelect`/`ForgeMultiselect` floating listbox rendered through the write-once
`ForgeDropdown` (combobox in its `trigger` slot, list in its default slot, via the
neutral named-slot passing syntax), the `useId`
composable replaced by the shared `nextFieldId` `useRef` helper
(`field-id.ts`), the `ForgeSlider` pointer-drag thumb substituted with a native
`<input type="range">`, the `ForgeOtpInput` Vue ref-array with a single container
ref + `querySelectorAll`, the `ForgePhoneInput` parse/format/validate delegated to
**`@mission-platform/phone-number`** through its co-located framework-agnostic `phone.ts`
helper, the `ForgeLocationInput` DD/DM/DMS conversion delegated to its co-located
framework-agnostic `location.ts` (with its lat/lng text buffers held in
`useState` and resynced via `useEffect`, and its child layout classes moved onto
wrapper `<div>`s), the `ForgeCalendar` month grid driven by **`luxon`** (its `ref`
view state → `useState`, its `computed` grid → `useMemo`, and its external-sync
`watch` → `useEffect`), the floating date/time pickers (`ForgeDateInput`,
`ForgeDateRangeInput`, `ForgeDateTimeRangeInput`, `ForgeTimeInput`,
`ForgeTimeRangeInput`) composing `ForgeCalendar` and/or scrollable time lists
inside a teleported, CSS-anchor-positioned popover (the `ForgePopover` recipe,
replacing `@floating-ui` + `useZIndex`) with their parse/format/clamp logic
delegated to the co-located framework-agnostic `date-time.ts` (and the SFC
hover-driven dual-month range grid substituted with two composed
`ForgeCalendar`s), icons with text glyphs, the `useI18n` labels with
plain props, and `v-model`/emits with the controlled
`modelValue`/`onUpdateModelValue` + callback-prop convention), and the
**complete** `Components/Communication` group (`ForgeChatBubble` composing
`ForgeAvatar`/`ForgeTypography` with the `avatar`/`footer` exposed as the
`avatarContent`/`footer` named slots, and `ForgeChatArea` whose `onMounted`/`watch`/`ResizeObserver`
auto-scroll is reproduced with one neutral `useEffect`)
migrated from `@mission-platform/components`. The grouped components that the
SFCs built with `provide`/`inject` (`ForgeAccordion`, `ForgeTimeline`) or by
introspecting slot VNodes (`ForgeCarousel`) are **flattened** into a single
`items`/`slides`-array component — the same approach as `ForgeTabs`. The
**complete** `Components/Overlays` group is now migrated too: the **popup**
members (`ForgeTooltip`, `ForgePopover`, `ForgeDropdown`) portal their panel to
`document.body` through the neutral `<Teleport>` primitive (compiled to React
`createPortal` / Vue `<Teleport>`, mounted only while open), and their
`@floating-ui` positioning is replaced by
the **CSS Anchor Positioning API** (`anchor-name`/`position-anchor`/`position-area` +
`position-try-fallbacks` + `@position-try`, plus `anchor-size(width)` for the
dropdown's width match), with `<Transition>` dropped; the **modal** members
(`ForgeDialog`/`ForgeModal`) render as a **native `<dialog>`** driven with
`showModal()`/`close()` (so the browser owns the top layer, `::backdrop` scrim,
focus trap, and `Escape`-to-close), with `<Transition>` replaced by a CSS
`@starting-style` fade, their `header`/`footer` exposed as **named slots**
(presence-detected with `hasSlot`), and `useZIndex`/`useRouterClose` dropped. The
**external-toolchain editors/viewers** are migrated too: `ForgeCodeBlock`
(**`highlight.js`**) and `ForgeMarkdownInput` (**`marked`**) keep their dep
verbatim, compute the HTML in `useMemo`, and inject it into a `useRef` host via
a `useEffect` `innerHTML` assignment (the `ForgeWindowPopout` escape-hatch,
replacing `v-html` — so SSR renders the static shell); `ForgeMonacoEditor` mounts
Monaco imperatively in a `useEffect` on a `useRef` host with a dynamic
`import('monaco-editor')` (kept out of the synchronous module graph for
SSG-safety); spell/grammar checking reaches **parity** with the SFC — when
`spellCheck` is set it lazily `import()`s the framework-agnostic
`attachHunspellMonaco`/`attachHarperMonaco` cores from
`@mission-platform/hunspell`/`@mission-platform/harper` (the same cores the Vue
`useHunspellMonaco`/`useHarperMonaco` composables now delegate to). Finally the **form
meta-components**: `ForgeSchemaForm` and `ForgeFormBuilder` reach **full parity**
with their Vue counterparts, both driven by a JSON Schema through the shared
**`@mission-platform/forms-core`** (Ajv validation, `ui.visibleWhen` conditional
fields, nested field sets, multi-step wizards) — `ForgeSchemaForm` resolves its
controls with a static `switch` (replacing `<component :is>`) and `ForgeFormBuilder`
ships the palette/canvas/properties/condition/steps editors with native HTML5
drag-and-drop, a live preview, and JSON-schema export; `ForgeFormWizard` (a `steps`
array with per-step `content` props replacing the scoped slots), and `ForgeScheduler`
(the full five-view calendar — day/3-day/week time grids, month grid, year grid —
with pointer drag/resize and a `ForgeDialog` event dialog, driven by the shared
**`@mission-platform/scheduler-core`** for recurrence expansion + grid collision
layout) — so **every** `@mission-platform/components` member that can be
modelled now has a write-once counterpart; the **forms** behaviours (Ajv
validation / JSON-Schema resolution + the form-builder field ⇄ schema model) and
the **scheduler** behaviours (RFC 5545 recurrence expansion + grid/time-slot
collision layout) now live in the shared **`@mission-platform/forms-core`** and
**`@mission-platform/scheduler-core`** packages consumed by both frameworks, and
the Monaco spell/grammar checking now lives in the shared
`attachHunspellMonaco`/`attachHarperMonaco` cores (in
`@mission-platform/hunspell`/`@mission-platform/harper`) consumed by both the Vue
composables and the write-once `ForgeMonacoEditor`. The toast store +
`ForgeToastContainer` orchestration and the `ForgeTypography` truncate popup (via
CSS Anchor Positioning) are likewise restored, so there are no remaining
out-of-scope behavioural gaps. The neutral dialect
models named slots, **scoped slots** (`<Slot name="row" item={…} />`), the
React-style hooks, and
cross-framework events as **callback props** (`onOpenChange`/`onClose`/…, which
the compiler maps to Vue emits/`v-model` and pass-through React callbacks), and
now models Vue `<Teleport>` via the neutral `<Teleport>` primitive (compiled to
React `createPortal` / Vue's built-in `<Teleport>`), the enter/leave
`<Transition>` and the keyed-list `<TransitionGroup>` (enter/leave/move) via the
neutral transition primitives (compiled to Vue's built-ins / the
`@mission-platform/forge/react` CSS-class drivers — e.g. `ForgeDrawer`'s slide/fade
and `ForgeToastContainer`'s stack), the dynamic host tag via `<Dynamic is>`, and
provide/inject via the neutral context primitives; it also replaces the
`@floating-ui` popup with the **CSS Anchor Positioning API** (as the migrated
`Components/Overlays` popups do). The few remaining substitutions
(`ForgeWindowPopout`'s cloned-HTML snapshot, and `ForgeVerticalLayout` forwarding
its column slots into the backing `ForgeDrawer`, …) are documented per-component above.

## Source layout

Each component is self-contained in its own folder under `src/components/`:

```
src/components/<component-name>/
├── <component-name>.tsx          # the write-once neutral component (JSX → MpElement)
├── <component-name>.module.scss  # co-located CSS Module, @layer mp.components (no :global)
├── <component-name>.stories.tsx  # Storybook story (consumes the built ./vue subpath)
├── <component-name>.spec.ts      # cross-framework SSR parity test (via the @mission-platform/forge adapters)
└── index.ts                      # re-exports the component + its prop types
```

Some components additionally share framework-agnostic logic through a plain
helper module that sits next to the component folders (e.g.
`src/components/theme-store.ts` — the observable singleton theme store shared by
`ForgeThemeToggle`/`ForgeThemeProvider`, the substitute for Vue `provide`/`inject` —
and `src/components/theme-composer-store.ts`, the pure config→CSS-variable
helpers for `ForgeThemeComposer`; and `src/components/forge-phone-input/phone.ts`,
the `@mission-platform/phone-number`-backed parse/format/validate helpers for
`ForgePhoneInput` — which lives **inside** a component folder but still qualifies
because it imports no neutral/JSX primitives, so the external
`@mission-platform/phone-number` dependency travels verbatim onto both framework builds;
and `src/components/date-time.ts`, the parse/format/clamp/range helpers shared
by the five date/time pickers).
A component imports such a helper with a normal
relative import (`import { … } from '../theme-store'`); `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge`
recognises it is **not** a sibling component and copies it verbatim into both the
React and Vue generated trees (re-pointing the import), so the shared logic is
authored once and runs unchanged on both frameworks.

`src/components/index.ts` is the aggregate barrel that re-exports every
component folder. There are **no** `src/react.ts` / `src/vue.ts` files: the
per-framework entries are generated from that barrel by
`@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` at build time (see "How it is built").

## Styling

Every `.module.scss` is authored as a **CSS Module** whose rules live in the
shared `@layer mp.components` cascade layer (matching `@mission-platform/components`)
— there is **no `:global`**. The two-stage compiler then scopes each framework's
styling **by that framework's own idiomatic mechanism**:

- **React** keeps the **CSS Module**: the generated React source imports
  `./<name>.module.scss` and applies the **hashed** class names (the source's
  `className={[styles[...], …]}` attribute compiles to `className={classNames(…)}`).
- **Vue** inlines the same SCSS as a **non-scoped `<style lang="scss">`** block
  in the generated SFC, so the Vue build uses **plain (BEM) class names** (the
  `@layer mp.components` wrapper is preserved). The compiler rewrites every
  `styles['x']` / `styles[`x`]` read — including computed object keys like
  `{ [styles['x--mod']]: cond }` — to its literal class name, so the native
  `:class` binding still produces the right (plain) classes. The block is **not** `scoped`: these
  SFCs render via a `<script>` render function and Vue only applies a
  `<style scoped>` `data-v-` attribute to the render function's root vnode, so
  nested elements would be left unstyled — the unique BEM names + `@layer`
  namespacing (matching `@mission-platform/components`) are relied on instead.

Enter/leave **transition** classes follow the same rule: components that animate
with the neutral `<Transition>`/`<TransitionGroup>` (`ForgeDrawer`'s slide/fade,
`ForgeToastContainer`'s stack) pass their styled phase classes as **explicit
class props** (`enterFromClass`/`enterActiveClass`/`leaveActiveClass`/
`leaveToClass`, …) sourced from `styles[...]`, so the classes are hashed on
React and plain BEM on Vue exactly like every other class — **never** the global
`:global(.<name>-…)` rules that a bare `name` prefix would require.

Either way, two authoring patterns are used:

- **Components that own their styling** (`ForgeBadge`, `ForgeButton`,
  `ForgeSeparator`, `ForgeMasonry`, `ForgeApplicationLayout`, `ForgeTypography`, `ForgeHero`,
  `ForgeDrawer`, `ForgeNavbar`, `ForgeVerticalLayout`, `ForgeWindowPopout`,
  `ForgeButtonGroup`, `ForgeIconButton`, `ForgeTag`, `ForgeQuote`, `ForgeList`,
  `ForgeCard`, `ForgeCollapse`, `ForgeTable`, `ForgeVirtualLogViewer`,
  `ForgeVirtualTreeView`, `ForgeTreeView`, `ForgeThemeToggle`, `ForgeThemeProvider`,
  `ForgeThemeComposer`, `ForgeSkeleton`, `ForgeSpinner`, `ForgeStatusIcon`,
  `ForgeProgressBar`, `ForgeAlertBanner`, `ForgeToast`, `ForgeResponsiveImage`,
  `ForgeResponsiveVideo`, `ForgeBackgroundVideo`, `ForgeCheckbox`, `ForgeRadio`,
  `ForgeSwitch`, `ForgeInput`, `ForgeTextarea`, `ForgeNumberStepper`, `ForgeSlider`,
  `ForgeRangeInput`, `ForgeColorInput`,
  `ForgeOtpInput`, `ForgeRating`, `ForgeSearchInput`, `ForgeFieldSet`,
  `ForgeChatBubble`, `ForgeFileInput`, `ForgeAccordion`, `ForgeCarousel`,
  `ForgeTimeline`, `ForgeRadioGroup`, `ForgeSelect`, `ForgeMultiselect`,
  `ForgePhoneInput`, `ForgeChatArea`, `ForgeQrCode`, `ForgeLocationInput`,
  `ForgeCalendar`, `ForgeDateInput`, `ForgeDateRangeInput`,
  `ForgeDateTimeRangeInput`, `ForgeTimeInput`, `ForgeTimeRangeInput`,
  `ForgeTooltip`, `ForgePopover`, `ForgeDropdown`, `ForgeDialog`,
  `ForgeModal`, `ForgeCodeBlock`, `ForgeMarkdownInput`, `ForgeMonacoEditor`,
  `ForgeSchemaForm`, `ForgeFormWizard`, `ForgeFormBuilder`, `ForgeScheduler`) import
  their module (`import styles from './x.module.scss'`) and assemble class names
  with the platform-owned `className={[…]}` attribute (string / array /
  `{ class: boolean }` forms — the author never imports the helper). The build
  emits **one CSS asset per component** and wires each
  component's JS chunk to import its own stylesheet (React via the copied module,
  Vue via the SFC `<style>`), so consuming a single component pulls in **only**
  that component's styling — no combined stylesheet, and no `./vue.css` /
  `./react.css` import is needed.
  (`ForgeMasonry` is a hybrid: it owns the `.forge-masonry` container box and the
  per-child break-safety rule — the neutral equivalent of the Vue original's
  `:slotted(*)` — in its module, while still applying the dynamic multi-column
  properties inline.)
- **Inline-styled components** (`ForgeStack`, `ForgeGrid`,
  `ForgeInView`, `ForgeAvatar`, `ForgeVirtualList`, `ForgeVirtualTable`) lay out via inline styles; their module holds only the demo
  decoration classes, which the co-located **story** consumes through the
  module's hashed class map (`import styles …` + `:class="styles['…']"`).

## Exports

| Subpath | Exports |
|---|---|
| `@mission-platform/components/react` | `Badge`, `Button`, `InView`, `Stack`, `Grid`, `Separator`, `Masonry`, `ApplicationLayout`, `Typography`, `Hero`, `Drawer`, `Navbar`, `VerticalLayout`, `WindowPopout`, `Avatar`, `ButtonGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tag`, `Quote`, `List`, `Card`, `Collapse`, `Table`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `StatusIcon`, `ProgressBar`, `AlertBanner`, `Toast`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `NumberStepper`, `Slider`, `RangeInput`, `ColorInput`, `OtpInput`, `Rating`, `SearchInput`, `FieldSet`, `FileInput`, `Select`, `Multiselect`, `PhoneInput`, `ChatBubble`, `ChatArea`, `Accordion`, `Carousel`, `Timeline`, `QrCode`, `LocationInput`, `Calendar`, `DateInput`, `DateRangeInput`, `DateTimeRangeInput`, `TimeInput`, `TimeRangeInput`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Dropdown`, `Dialog`, `Modal`, `CodeBlock`, `MarkdownInput`, `MonacoEditor`, `SchemaForm`, `FormWizard`, `FormBuilder`, `Scheduler` (the public name of each `Base*` component) — compiled to React function components at build time by `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` (`dist/react/index.js`). Each component is its own ESM chunk that imports its own CSS, so the library tree-shakes (unused components, styles included, are dropped). |
| `@mission-platform/components/vue` | `Badge`, `Button`, `InView`, `Stack`, `Grid`, `Separator`, `Masonry`, `ApplicationLayout`, `Typography`, `Hero`, `Drawer`, `Navbar`, `VerticalLayout`, `WindowPopout`, `Avatar`, `ButtonGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tag`, `Quote`, `List`, `Card`, `Collapse`, `Table`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `StatusIcon`, `ProgressBar`, `AlertBanner`, `Toast`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `NumberStepper`, `Slider`, `RangeInput`, `ColorInput`, `OtpInput`, `Rating`, `SearchInput`, `FieldSet`, `FileInput`, `Select`, `Multiselect`, `PhoneInput`, `ChatBubble`, `ChatArea`, `Accordion`, `Carousel`, `Timeline`, `QrCode`, `LocationInput`, `Calendar`, `DateInput`, `DateRangeInput`, `DateTimeRangeInput`, `TimeInput`, `TimeRangeInput`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Dropdown`, `Dialog`, `Modal`, `CodeBlock`, `MarkdownInput`, `MonacoEditor`, `SchemaForm`, `FormWizard`, `FormBuilder`, `Scheduler` (the public name of each `Base*` component) — compiled to Vue components at build time by `@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` (`dist/vue/index.js`). Each component is its own ESM chunk that imports its own CSS, so the library tree-shakes. |
| `@mission-platform/components/cms/storyblok/react` | `ApplicationLayoutBlok`, `BadgeBlok`, `ButtonBlok`, `InViewBlok`, `StackBlok`, `GridBlok`, `SeparatorBlok`, `MasonryBlok` — React **blok wrappers** that bind Storyblok's `blok` prop onto the built `./react` component (`storyblokEditable`, nested `StoryblokComponent`) (`dist/cms/storyblok/react/index.js`). Each wrapper's `blok` prop is **precisely typed** (`SbBlokData & { … }`, one member per schema field), not an open `Record<string, unknown>`. Requires the `@storyblok/react` peer. |
| `@mission-platform/components/cms/storyblok/vue` | `ApplicationLayoutBlok`, `BadgeBlok`, `ButtonBlok`, `InViewBlok`, `StackBlok`, `GridBlok`, `SeparatorBlok`, `MasonryBlok` — Vue **blok wrappers** that bind Storyblok's `blok` prop onto the built `./vue` component (`v-editable`, nested `StoryblokComponent`) (`dist/cms/storyblok/vue/index.js`). Each wrapper's `blok` prop is **precisely typed** (`SbBlokData & { … }`, one member per schema field), not an open `Record<string, unknown>`. Requires the `@storyblok/vue` peer. |
| `@mission-platform/components/cms/storyblok/components.json` | The aggregate Storyblok **blok configuration** — `{ "components": [ … ] }`, the shape `storyblok push-components` consumes. The framework-agnostic create-shape `<component>.json` files sit alongside it in `dist/cms/storyblok/`. |
| `@mission-platform/components/styles` | A bare side-effect SCSS entry (`src/styles/_a11y.scss`) — a global `prefers-reduced-motion` reset mirroring the Vue component library's global a11y safety net. Import it once (`import '@mission-platform/components/styles'`) for the app-wide reduced-motion behaviour, independent of the per-component CSS that loads automatically with each imported component. |

Both the `./react` and `./vue` entries additionally re-export **every component
under its neutral `Base`-prefixed name** (`ForgeBadge`, `ForgeButton`, `ForgeCard`,
…) as an alias of the same component, so a consumer can import under either the
bare (`Button`) or the `Base`-prefixed (`ForgeButton`) convention. Each
component's **public types** (variants, option shapes, props interfaces, scoped-
slot scopes such as `VirtualTableCellScope`, the `MonacoEditorTheme` /
`MonacoReadyContext` types, …) are re-exported from the same subpath too.

There are **no** `./vue.css` / `./react.css` exports: each component's chunk
imports its own per-component CSS, so simply importing a component applies its
styling (`"sideEffects": ["**/*.css", "**/*.scss"]` keeps that CSS while letting
the JS tree-shake). The standalone `./styles` entry is the one global,
side-effect-only stylesheet (the reduced-motion reset).

There is no framework-neutral root (`@mission-platform/components`) export:
the package builds straight to React and Vue, so always import the matching
subpath.

`react`, `react-dom`, `vue`, `@storyblok/react`, and `@storyblok/vue` are all
**optional peer dependencies**; install only the framework (and, for the
Storyblok wrappers, the matching `@storyblok/*` package) you target and import
the matching subpath.

## Usage

### React

```tsx
import { Badge, Button } from '@mission-platform/components/react';

export function Toolbar() {
  return (
    <Button variant="primary" badge={3}>
      Save
    </Button>
  );
}
```

### Vue 3

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge, Button } from '@mission-platform/components/vue';
</script>

<template>
  <Button variant="primary" :badge="3">Save</Button>
</template>
```

## How it is built

`vite.config.ts` builds **both frameworks together** with the
`@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` **two-stage compiler** — there is no neutral
build and there are **no hand-authored `react.ts` / `vue.ts` entry files**. The
`build` script clears `dist` once up front, then runs the config once per target
framework (selected by `--mode`), each emitting into its own subtree:

- `vue` (default) — the generated `vue` entry → `dist/vue/`.
- `react` — the generated `react` entry → `dist/react/`.
- `cms-storyblok-vue` — the generated Vue blok wrappers → `dist/cms/storyblok/vue/`.
- `cms-storyblok-react` — the generated React blok wrappers → `dist/cms/storyblok/react/`.

The two Storyblok modes call the plugin's `generateCmsArtifacts` (Stage 1) to
emit the blok configuration JSON + the framework blok wrappers into a build
cache, then compile the wrappers with the same Stage-2 toolchain as the
matching framework. Each wrapper imports the package's **own built** `./react`
/ `./vue` subpath and `@storyblok/{react,vue}` — all kept **external** — so the
wrappers stay thin. `generateCmsArtifacts` already synthesises the wrapper
entry's **precisely typed** `index.d.ts` (each wrapper is a framework component
taking a single `blok` prop typed `SbBlokData & { … }`, one member per schema
field), which a small local plugin ships verbatim; another copies the
framework-agnostic JSON (`components.json` plus one `<component>.json` per
component) into the shared `dist/cms/storyblok/`.

Each framework build runs with **`preserveModules` + `cssCodeSplit`**, so every
component is emitted as its own JS chunk **and** its own CSS asset; a small
`jsxComponentsCssImportPlugin` re-links each chunk to its extracted CSS (Vite
lib mode emits the CSS but does not import it). The two frameworks live in
separate `dist/<framework>/` subtrees so their identically-named per-component
chunks never collide.

For each framework:

- **Stage 1** — `generateFrameworkSources` reads the neutral components barrel
  and emits a per-framework source tree into a build-cache directory: React
  `.tsx` modules (`class` → `className`, `h` → `React.createElement`), or real
  Vue `.vue` SFCs (`<script lang="tsx">` with `defineComponent`/`setup`, the
  React-style hooks translated to Vue reactivity/lifecycle — `useState` → `ref`,
  `useRef` → `ref`, `useEffect` → `onMounted` + `watch` + cleanup). It returns
  the generated entry used as the Vite `lib.entry`.
- **Stage 2** — the framework's own toolchain compiles that tree natively: the
  classic-`h` React JSX transform (`reactJsxPlugin()`) or `@vitejs/plugin-vue`
  (+ `@vitejs/plugin-vue-jsx`).

`jsxComponentsEntryDtsPlugin` synthesises each entry `.d.ts`
(`dist/<framework>/index.d.ts`, importing the props types from
`dist/components`), and plain `tsc` (not `vue-tsc`) emits the neutral
components' own declarations into `dist/components/**`. `dist` therefore
contains `dist/vue/` and `dist/react/` (each with `index.js` + per-component
chunks + per-component CSS + `index.d.ts`), the Storyblok output
(`dist/cms/storyblok/{vue,react}/` blok wrappers + `index.d.ts`, plus the shared
`dist/cms/storyblok/components.json` and per-component `<component>.json`), and the
shared `dist/components/**` declarations, but no neutral `index`.

## Adding a new component

1. Create the folder `src/components/<name>/` and add
   `<name>.tsx` (import `h`, any hooks, and types from
   `@mission-platform/forge`; author it in JSX returning an `MpElement`, driving
   dynamic classes with the platform-owned `className={[…]}` attribute — never
   import the `classNames` helper), an
   `index.ts` that re-exports the component and its prop types (export the props
   interface as `<PublicName>Properties` so the generated entry can type it),
   and — when it needs styling — a `<name>.module.scss` (a CSS Module in
   `@layer mp.components`, **no `:global`**). For a component that owns its
   styling, `import styles from './<name>.module.scss'` and build the class with
   the `className={[styles['…'], …]}` attribute; for an inline-styled primitive whose module is
   only demo decoration, leave the module to be consumed by the story instead.
2. Re-export the folder from `src/components/index.ts`. **That's it for wiring**
   — the `react` / `vue` entries (and the matching `storyblok/{react,vue}` blok
   wrappers + the blok configuration JSON) are generated from the barrel by the
   plugin, so the component is automatically exported under its public name (the
   `Base` prefix is stripped; the Vue build compiles it to a `.vue`
   `defineComponent` SFC, the React build to a function component, and the
   Storyblok build derives its `<Name>Blok` wrapper + `<name>.json` config).
3. Add `<name>.spec.ts` (a cross-framework SSR parity test via the
   `@mission-platform/forge` adapters) and `<name>.stories.tsx` (importing the
   built `@mission-platform/components/vue` subpath; a story for an
   inline-styled primitive also imports its `.module.scss` as a hashed map and
   binds `:class="styles['…']"`) in the same folder. The story is picked up by
   Storybook, which globs the package source (typography is the dedicated
   exception and is discovered from `packages/typography/src/**/*.stories.*`).
4. Update this file.

## Spacing & line-height props (added)

Every layout primitive plus a focused set of components now accept optional
**`padding` / `margin`** props on the shared `2xs … 2xl` t-shirt spacing scale
(`2xs`, `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `2xl`). Each step maps to a named
`--mp-spacing-*` design token (from `@mission-platform/tokens`) and is applied
as a **token-driven CSS class** (from the shared `spacing.module.scss`) — not an
inline style:

- `ForgeStack`, `ForgeGrid`, `ForgeMasonry` — both `padding` and `margin`.
- `ForgeButton` — both `padding` and `margin` (override the size's intrinsic box).
- `ForgeSeparator` — both `padding` and `margin` (a set `margin` overrides the
  legacy `spacing` prop).
- `ForgeCard` — outer `margin` only (its existing `padding` prop keeps the
  region scale `none`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`).

Additional layout options added at the same time:

- `ForgeGrid` gains a responsive **`minColumnWidth`** prop: when set, the grid
  switches to an `auto-fit` track list (`repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(<width>,
  100%), 1fr))`) that wraps as many min-width columns as fit, so `cols` is
  ignored.
- Typography is owned by `@mission-platform/typography`; import
  `ForgeTypography` and its public types from that package.
